players.product: Capacitor-grade tantalum powder and tantalum wire (main raw materials for tantalum capacitors); also high-purity tantalum powder, tantalum ingots and 12-inch tantalum target blanks

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,039,815,580.48, up 30.50%, on capacity released by the raised-fund projects, ample orders in hand lifting sales volume, and higher selling prices as tantalum-niobium raw-material prices rose; product gross margin rose 0.36 percentage points. Net profit attributable RMB 122,280,166.15, down 15.52% (excluding non-recurring items RMB 120,303,953.47, down 12.57%); the tantalum-niobium core business's total profit rose 5.19%. The company attributes the profit decline to a 66.12% drop in investment income from its associate Northwest Rare Metal Materials Research Institute Ningxia, FX losses from RMB appreciation, higher interest costs from larger financing for raw-material purchases, and a time lag in passing raw-material price increases through to product prices.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report, revenue mix: tantalum-niobium and alloy products RMB 1,036,945,594.24 (99.71% of revenue, up 32.31%) at an 18.88% gross margin; titanium products fell 94.13% to RMB 606,151.06. Overseas sales RMB 497,737,967.12 (47.87% of revenue, up 77.02%); domestic sales RMB 542,077,613.36 (52.13%, up 5.13%).
quarterly_data.figure: Overseas sales RMB 497,737,967.12 (+77.02%); tantalum-niobium products gross margin 18.88%

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: inventories rose to RMB 1,358,279,880.87 (from RMB 926,603,889.60 at end-2025) on larger raw-material reserves and work-in-progress stocked for sales orders in hand; operating cash flow was an outflow of RMB 539,884,869.24 as the company stepped up tantalum-niobium raw-material purchases and strategic stockpiling for its larger order book. The company says it signed a 3600-tonne ferro-tantalum-niobium alloy contract and is pushing tantalum-niobium scrap recycling, and it set up a new subsidiary, Ningxia Zhongse Key Metal Materials, for tantalum-niobium hydrometallurgy to raise raw-material self-sufficiency.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: R&D input RMB 23,936,450.47 (down 2.33%). The company says its high-purity tantalum powder for 6N-and-above high-purity tantalum targets broke through two core technologies (deep removal of trace impurities and low-contamination smelting); it mastered processing of two new 1.3GHz niobium RF superconducting cavity models; niobium-based refractory alloy powder and multi-laser additive manufacturing reached small-batch production; and its high-reliability 50K tantalum powder was selected as a representative result of a central-SOE advanced nonferrous materials alliance.
